summary: A proposal to add an ai_query function to PySpark that takes a prompt column and returns model responses, with a prototype that passed end‑to‑end tests on Databricks and Amazon Bedrock. Participants discuss monitoring, increasing parallelism, handling large PRs, and suggest improvements such as cleaner invocation via GitHub UI and more concise review comments. The discussion proposes extending Spark’s Real-Time Mode to eligible batch SQL and DataFrame queries, enabling pipelined shuffle that overlaps producer, transfer, and consumer stages to reduce latency. The proposal introduces a method to join streaming data with external storage by performing on-demand lookups instead of loading the entire static side.
